steps.title: Grunt copied this page
steps.titleZh: 这个页面是 Grunt 复制的
steps.text: The heading says it: this page is `app/index.html`, copied into `dist/` by Grunt. A task runner such as Grunt runs named steps in the order you list them. Here `clean` deletes `dist/`, then `copy` copies everything under `app/` into it.
steps.textZh: 标题已经说明了：这个页面就是 `app/index.html`，由 Grunt 复制到了 `dist/`。Grunt 这样的任务运行器，会按你列出的顺序执行一个个有名字的步骤。这里先由 `clean` 删除 `dist/`，再由 `copy` 把 `app/` 下的所有文件复制进去。

watch.label: Page scripts (not counting the guide)
watch.labelZh: 页面脚本（不含说明面板）

steps.title: An exact copy
steps.text: Nothing was changed, combined or minified on the way. This step fetches each file from `dist/` and from `app/` and compares them.
steps.textZh: 复制过程中没有任何修改、合并或压缩。这一步会分别从 `dist/` 和 `app/` 获取每个文件，再逐一比较。

action.run: const files = ['index.html', 'js/index.js']; Promise.all(files.map((f) => Promise.all([fetch(f), fetch('../app/' + f)].map((p) => p.then((r) => r.text()))))).then((pairs) => pairs.forEach(([built, source], i) => console.log('dist/' + files[i], 'is identical to app/' + files[i] + ':', built === source)))

expectConsole: dist/index.html is identical to app/index.html: true
dist/js/index.js is identical to app/js/index.js: true

steps.title: No dependency graph
steps.text: `js/index.js` is an empty file, and nothing here reads `import` statements: Grunt knows only the files and the steps you list, not which file needs which. That is the main difference from a bundler, which builds a dependency graph from the imports.
steps.textZh: `js/index.js` 是个空文件，这里也没有任何步骤读取 `import` 语句：Grunt 只知道你列出的文件和步骤，不知道哪个文件依赖哪个文件。这是它和打包器最主要的区别，打包器会根据 import 建立依赖图。

action.run: fetch('js/index.js').then((r) => r.text()).then((t) => console.log('js/index.js size:', new Blob([t]).size, 'bytes'))
